msContents.summary: Herbal in Italian and Latin: followed by notes and extracts on urines, an uncompleted dictionary of diseases and remedies, medical receipts, etc. Mainly the compiler's holograph MS., but with additions by several early 16th cent. hands. There are two watermarks on the paper, variants of the bull's-head and serpent entwined round a pole, one surmounted by a cross, the other by a five-petalled flower. These appear to be Nos. 15376 and 15394 of Briquet, and are assigned to Venice 1479-92. Illustrated by 283 rough drawings of medicinal plants, of which 251 are coloured in water-colour, some partly coloured: there are also a number of pen-drawings of urine flasks. On fol. 90 is a remarkable illustration of a Mandrake showing the male and female plant, a dog with a rope attached to one of them, and a youth in 15th cent. costume blowing a horn. Many of the plant illustrations are accompanied by notes in Latin or Italian on their virtues and uses. Ff. 1-8 Index by Ferandus, with additions by a later hand. [li]Fernandus, N. Herbal: Fol. 9v - 201 Illustrations and some descriptions, with a few additions by later hands.[/li][li]Scotus, M. Consegli di poveri infirmi. (Extract on urines): Fol. 202 AL nome de christo sia // Lo primo libro de consegli di poueri Infirmi e vtile per ciascauno / pouero medico secundo che mette michael scoto astrologo del impera / dor fedrigo ... 208 le dui 7e vltime vrine significano meza digestione.[/li][li]Ketham, J. de. Fascicolo di medicina. (Extract on urines): Fol. 208v El comenza el dignissimo fasciculo de medicina in uolgare el qualo / atracta de tute le infirmitate del corpo vmano .../.../e prima la exposicion del colore de le / vrine e iudicio de quello... 210v (End)...dichiarara quello di fresco cun la dona / aueua vsato.[/li][li]Ferandus, N.: Ff. 211-218 Illustrations of herbs, notes on urines: with two illustrations of herbs, by a later hand.[/li][li]Gualterus Agilon. De urinis. (Extract): Fol. 219 de vrinis gualteri eprimo [sic] de 4or complessionibus [sic]. // vrina alba uel lactea ut aqua purissima... 222v ... et sic sequitur rubor genarum.[/li][li]Gerardus Bituricensis (?). De coloribus urinarum: Fol. 223 Incipit tractatus vrine magistri girardi et primo de citrino collore [sic] / est dicendum... 227... si erit cum febre erit / sibi cotidiana de collera [sic] naturali.[/li][li]Ferandus, N. Tractatus: mainly on urines: Fol. 228 Tractatus. Tractatus mei nicolai ferandi. // Ego nicolaus quondam alberici ferandi de francia auxilio / diuino mediante Intendo hic solum terminare de aliquibus / rebus... 230v ... sine egri eleuacione confirmatam / litargiam significat.[/li][li]Gaddesden, J. de. Rosa medicinae. (Extract on urines): Fol. 231 Pratica. / Pratica Joannis anglici clarissimi ab operis prestancia / rossa [sic] medicine nuncupata tractanda de vrinis. // Vrina rubicunda ignia subtillis...233v ... et est tardior pulsu quartane.[/li][li]Ferandus, N. Notes: Ff. 234-250 Miscellaneous medical notes, mainly concerned with urines, with six interpolated drawings and descriptions of medicinal plants, two by a later hand, medical receipts, etc.[/li][li]Ferandus, N. Alphabetical list of diseases and remedies: Fol. 251 Alopecia, sie cascamento de capilli...[The following entries are partly in Latin and partly in Italian.] 315 [Infiata dentro dal corpo per casone de cargo sforziato] (Ends)...e ungiti sopra la inflacion. Fff. 315-320 Medical receipts by later hands, including a note on fol. 317 dated 1519. 321-322 Index to ff. 225-320 by a later hand.[/li][li](Anon.) De ligno guaiaco. In Italian, by a later hand: Fol. 322v Capitolo ouer Receta de lo Arbore ouer ligno deto guagiana / Remedio Contra El mal galicho Esperimentato. // Dichano quali che per raportar merce nauichano in India auer Veduto lo / Arbore che uxano quali de india Contra el morbo galicho...325v ...et si conserua dapoi Rechuperata mediante la grazia de giexu / Cristo el qual sia laudato. Finis. 326, 327 Blank. 327v, 328 Medical receipts by a later hand. On fol. 1, and repeated on fol. 9, is a partly erased inscription in a later 16th cent. hand 'Est conventus Sanctae Mariae de [Grazie?] Ordinis Predicatorum'. [? Venice.].[/li]
